Interface PlayerRegionSubscription

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface PlayerRegionSubscription extends AutoCloseable
A handle to one resolution of the shared player grid.

The world is divided into square cells of cellSize() blocks. The grid records which players are in which cell and is refreshed by the manager at a fixed interval (1 Hz by default). Every subscriber of the same cell size shares the same underlying grid, so subscribing is cheap. Queries are only possible through a subscription, and a subscription only answers for its own resolution.

Query tiers
TierPrecisionCost
Near Cell-granular: the 3x3 cells around the point, no distance check Lowest
WithinBounds Exact square check on each candidate Medium
WithinRadius Exact circular distance check on each candidate Highest

  • Method Details

    • cellSize

      int cellSize()
      Returns the cell edge length of this grid in blocks.

      Always a power of two.

      Returns:
      cell edge length in blocks

    • getPlayersNear

      List<org.bukkit.entity.Player> getPlayersNear(org.bukkit.World world, int x, int z)
      Returns every player in the 3x3 block of cells centered on the cell containing (x, z).

      No distance check is performed. Every player within cellSize() blocks of the point on both axes is guaranteed to be included.

      Allocates a new list on every call.

      Parameters:
      world - world to search
      x - block X coordinate of the center
      z - block Z coordinate of the center
      Returns:
      a new, caller-owned list, empty if no players are found (never null)

    • forEachNear

      void forEachNear(org.bukkit.World world, int x, int z, Consumer<org.bukkit.entity.Player> action)
      Visits every player in the 3x3 block of cells centered on the cell containing (x, z).
      Parameters:
      world - world to search
      x - block X coordinate of the center
      z - block Z coordinate of the center
      action - called once per player found; must not modify the grid

    • anyNear

      boolean anyNear(org.bukkit.World world, int x, int z)
      Returns whether at least one player is in the 3x3 block of cells around (x, z).

      Same selection as getPlayersNear(World, int, int). Stops at the first player found.

      Parameters:
      world - world to search
      x - block X coordinate of the center
      z - block Z coordinate of the center
      Returns:
      true if any player is in range, false otherwise

    • getPlayersWithinBounds

      List<org.bukkit.entity.Player> getPlayersWithinBounds(org.bukkit.World world, int x, int z, int radius)
      Returns every player whose X and Z are both within radius blocks of (x, z), that is, inside a square of half-width radius.

      Allocates a new list on every call.

      Parameters:
      world - world to search
      x - block X coordinate of the center
      z - block Z coordinate of the center
      radius - half-width of the square in blocks; values below zero and above the cell width return an empty list
      Returns:
      a new, caller-owned list, empty if no players are found (never null)

    • isActive

      boolean isActive()
      Returns whether this subscription is still open.

      A subscription is active from creation until close() is called or its owning plugin is disabled.

      Returns:
      true if queries return live results, false once closed

    • close

      void close()
      Closes this subscription and releases its claim on the grid.

      When the last subscription to a given cell size is closed, that grid stops being refreshed and its data is dropped.

      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
